business_summary: Daisue Construction Co., Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, engages in the construction business in Japan. The company constructs offices, logistics warehouses, factories, medical facilities, and buildings for weddings and funerals. It is also involved in condominium and refurbishment businesses. In addition, the company provides technologies and solutions, such as structural technology, construction technology, anti-earthquake technology, environmentally friendly technology, and quality technology. Further, it is involved in the insurance agency, nursing home, and labor dispatch businesses. Daisue Construction Co., Ltd. was founded in 1937 and is headquartered in Chuo, Japan.
business_summary_ko: 다이스에건설(주)는 자회사와 함께 일본에서 건설사업을 영위하고 있습니다. 사무실, 물류창고, 공장, 의료시설, 결혼식 및 장례식장 등을 건설하는 회사입니다. 콘도미니엄 및 재건축 사업에도 참여하고 있습니다. 또한 구조기술, 건설기술, 내진기술, 친환경기술, 품질기술 등의 기술과 솔루션을 제공하고 있습니다. 그 밖에 보험대리점, 요양원, 인력파견 사업에도 참여하고 있습니다. Daisue Construction Co., Ltd.는 1937년에 설립되었으며 일본 주오에 본사를 두고 있습니다.
